info.title: Files.com Universal API
info.description: Store files, manage folders, automate transfers, and orchestrate secure file operations.

post.description: Begins a file upload in Files.com.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

path.description: Path of the file to upload, including file name.

mkdirParents.description: Create missing parent folders automatically when true.

part.description: Specific multipart upload part number to begin.

parts.description: Total number of multipart upload parts.

ref.description: Resume token from a previous begin-upload response.

restart.description: Restart the upload sequence from a given part index.

withRename.description: Allow Files.com to rename the uploaded file to avoid conflicts.
